title: Patched leggings
description: this pack makes leggings uv and model be patched so it can be used with other texture packs as long as they don't change the leggings model!
body:
required: **[optifine](https://optifine.net/home) or [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)**

This resource pack patches the hole in leggings/pants on the armor model (drags uv to existing textures)

a copy of (probably deleted) pack _"No A$# Peeks"_ that is **outdated**

compatible with armor changing texture resource packs
